translations.web: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
translations.bsb: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.
translations.kjv: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
translations.asv: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.
